members.description: Gets or sets the connection string used for read and write operations.

members.description: Gets or sets the connection string used for read-only operations.

members.name: Serialization
members.description: Gets or sets the serialization conventions the library registers with the driver. Initialised to an instance whose switches are all off, so leaving it untouched keeps the driver's own behaviour. Setting it to null turns the automatic fallback in into a no-op and makes throw.

description: Options to control how the MongoRepository health check evaluates failures.

members.name: SingleFailureIsUnhealthy
members.description: If true: a single failing connection (read-only OR read/write) results in Unhealthy. If false: a single failure results in Degraded (default).

members.name: MissingConnectionIsFailure
members.description: If true: a missing (empty) connection string counts as a failure. If false: a missing connection string is treated as 'skipped' and does not degrade health (default).

description: Selects which MongoDB serialization conventions the library registers, and which types they apply to. Every switch is off by default, so an application that does not set any of them keeps the driver's out-of-the-box behaviour.

members.name: IgnoreExtraElements
members.description: Whether a stored document may carry fields the entity class does not declare.

members.name: IgnoreIfNull
members.description: Whether properties that are null are left out of the stored document.

members.name: Namespaces
members.description: The namespaces the conventions are limited to. Initialised so that the configuration binder fills it in place; setting it to null is treated as an empty list.

members.name: TypeFilter
members.description: An additional predicate that narrows the conventions to the types it accepts.

members.name: ConventionPackName
members.description: The name the convention pack is registered under in the driver's convention registry.
